profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at FlashGrid
profile.summary:
Systems Engineer/Systems Programmer/Systems Architect with 30+ years industry experience.

Specialties: Docker, Fedora, RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, DNS, Java, C, C++, TCP/IP Networking, Solaris, dtrace, VMware ESX/vSphere, Linux, FreeBSD, Illumos, samba development, perl, Python, Twisted, Klein, Trouble Shooting+Failure Analysis, System Engineering / Architecture, SMB 2.0/2.1/3.0, SmartOS, ZFS, illumos development, GlusterFS, ceph, Azure, node.js, next.js, React, knot, knot resolver, Kubernetes

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Advise the CEO on company-wide AI adoption strategy, including how AI fits into development methodology
• Own software development end to end, from architecture through implementation and code review
• Implemented Terraform automation to deploy the core product, high-availability database clusters, across AWS, GCP, and Azure
• Develop critical health-monitoring software for production clusters, where correctness directly affects uptime and data integrity
• Lead security vulnerability triage and impact analysis

positions.title: Sr. Infrastructure Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Designing / Architecting / Implementing for a new data center rollout:
** Load Balancing (HAProxy, OSPF ECMP, Arista)
** Hardware specification creation and review. 
** Baremetal provisioning using MAAS.
** VM provisioning
** Environment management   (Dev -> Test -> Prod)
** Ceph storage cluster (3PB Raw)
** DNS - Knot DNS + Knot Resolver

company.name: MGH & BWH Center for Clinical Data Science

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Architect
positions.description:
* Developed the architecture for a new website for Gillette.
** Developed the initial prototype Kubernetes infrastructure in AWS.
** Worked with React + next.js to help enable server side rendering (SSR) for SEO.
** Containerized front end next.js app with Docker.
** Helped create final development infrastructure in Terraform.
** Prototyped serverless next.js infrastructure for future use.
* Researched future directions for direct-to-consumer e-commerce architecture for P\&G.

positions.title: Principal Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Lead of the Installsuite Team.
* Architected, designed and worked on coding a REST API for installation monitoring 
* Code review for various projects.
* Incident Management as needed.

positions.title: Team Member
positions.description:
* Currently inactive.
* Worked: winbindd, waf, libraries, tdb, talloc, smbd.
* Primary focuses were: System performance, correctness and SMB2, SMB2.1, SMB3.0, SMB3.01, SMB3.10, SMB3.11.
* Past work: illumos maintainer.

positions.title: Technical Lead / Principal Software Engineer - Architect
positions.description:
* Samba development lead for Red Hat Storage
** Team spread across USA, Germany and India
** Heavy work on integrating Samba + Gluster
** Initial development of Samba + CephFS clustering
* Works with management team to set strategic directions for the product
* Troubleshoot systems and projects

positions.title: Team Lead / Senior Systems Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Samba Development Lead for MathWorks
* Illumos Systems Developer - Focus on Storage.
* Systems "Guru", with a focus on Overall Perfromance, Monitoring/Trending and *nix internals.
* Team Lead for internal infrastructure projects
* Main focus is on storage development projects
* Hardware specification for large projects.
* Trouble Shooting of systems and projects.
* Developed and maintain a sophisticated mission critical trending infrastructure.

positions.title: Java Programmer
positions.description:
* Created a database query framework to simplify query screen creation.
* Ported code from a 4GL to Java

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Java/Lisp Programmer, Heavy Porting and Optimization.

positions.title: Staff Member of the Technical Staff
positions.description:
* Unix Systems Programmer / Engineer
* System sizing and performance + optimization
* Supported remote sites
* Developed specialized network simulation software to support long distance network simulation on commodity hardware
* Embedded Lua interpeters into applications

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentor for Natick High School's robotics teams.  FIRST - FRC and FTC, helping with team philosophy, team responsibility definition, teaching of goals, and general observation and questioning.
Acted as a supplementary mentor for 3 teams while assisting FIRST in supporting the teams success.

projects.title: AI Orchestration (Personal Project)
projects.description: Built a private AI orchestration system that applies structured development methodology to agent-driven software work, with emphasis on review, verification, and correctness. Happy to discuss in more detail.

publications.title: The Mathworks: A Case Study in NAS
